author: fresh-agent
summary: Explain quotation using existing entry and shared pricing evidence; preserve every existing business.

claim.explanation: quote(quantity: int) accepts quantity without the positive-quantity validation used by buy and directly calls total(quantity).
total(quantity) returns quantity * 10, so integer zero and negative inputs also produce their multiplied value.
quote returns the numeric total directly; this path never calls save and has no order string or persistence step.

transitions.condition: quote is called with an integer quantity; no positivity guard is evaluated
total returns normally; quote returns that value to its caller

claim.explanation: Quotation starts at delivery.orders.quote, reuses policies.pricing.total, and returns a numeric amount. app.start exposes the quote callable but does not execute a quotation. The entry/pricing/return display sequence explains nested calls, not a recorded runtime trace.
assumptions: The caller invokes the quote callable with an integer; annotations are not runtime input validation.
issues: Caller selection/invocation after app.start is outside this source boundary; no execution edge is claimed from registration.
Currency, rounding, taxes, external persistence, and policy correctness are not specified by these four files.
